description: This is a Java test source file containing abstract test cases for the Device Registration API in the Eclipse Hono project. It defines a base class with multiple test methods verifying device registration assertions under various conditions.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationApiTests
classes.description: An abstract base test class for device registration API, providing common test cases for asserting device registration status, including success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a RegistrationClient instance for a specific tenant.

methods.name: isGatewayModeSupported
methods.description: Checks if gateway mode is supported in the current environment.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationSucceedsForDevice
methods.description: Verifies that asserting registration succeeds for a known device.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationSucceedsForDeviceViaGateway
methods.description: Verifies that asserting registration works for a device connected via a gateway.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForUnknownDevice
methods.description: Ensures asserting registration for a non-existing device fails with 404.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForNonExistingGateway
methods.description: Checks failure when asserting registration with a non-existing gateway (expects 403).

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForDisabledGateway
methods.description: Tests failure when asserting registration with a disabled gateway (expects 403).

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForUnauthorizedGateway
methods.description: Validates failure when an unauthorized gateway attempts to assert device registration (expects 403).

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForDisabledDevice
methods.description: Tests failure when asserting registration for a disabled device (expects 404).
